description: Hero case for false safety. php8.4-cli is patched at 8.4.27-1~deb13u1 and php -v agrees, so anything reading php -v concludes the host is fine. php8.4-fpm, which actually serves the traffic, is held at 8.4.16-1~deb13u1 and is affected. The verdict must be per package, and php -v must not be treated as evidence about php8.4-fpm.
why: OSV: Debian:13 php8.4 fixed in 8.4.27-1~deb13u1. php8.4-cli 8.4.27-1~deb13u1 is fixed, php8.4-fpm 8.4.16-1~deb13u1 is affected.
